Hi, I'm Teddy Stamatakos and I am an undergraduate student at UCLA studying economics. First and foremost I grew up in San Francisco, so it's to no surprise that my interests are in tech, innovation, and software and that these are the fields I principally work in. At the same time I am passionate about the arts; specifically film, design, and screenwriting, and I suppose prose if you would constitute it as an art. Three of my favorite books are The Alchemist by Paulo Coelho, The Road to Wigan Pier by George Orwell, and Steve Jobs by Walter Isaacson. With that in mind it's also to no surprise that I strongly believe in pursuing one's own dreams, mine being to blend technology, art and culture to promote a more liberated society.
